topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct and HIPAA sanctions policy; annual acknowledgment of POL-05 by employees, physicians, and practice users
evidence: EV-039 (code of conduct); EV-038 (acknowledgment report, 97% employees); EV-039 (sanctions log, 11 in 2025-2026)

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk reports from the vCISO, including affiliated practice service status
gap: Quarterly reporting formalized only from 2026-09; one meeting on record
remediation: Hold and minute each quarterly report through the observation period

control_description: Security Officer designation; vCISO reporting line; Director of Physician Services owns the practice service; RACI for service delivery
evidence: EV-034 (designation letter); EV-073 (organization chart); EV-073 (service RACI)

control_description: Background checks; role-based training; IT and help desk competencies for practice support
gap: No role-based security training for help desk staff who reset practice user passwords; agency screening not verified
remediation: Help desk identity verification training; agency attestation

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP and policies; sanctions applied
System inventory, data flows, and practice user list support control operation
evidence: EV-012 (CMDB); EV-025 (interface inventory); EV-005 (practice user roster)
gap: Device inventory 70% complete; practice user roster reconciled only at onboarding
remediation: Passive discovery (POAM-009); monthly practice roster reconciliation (POAM-001)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies, responsibilities, and security updates communicated to workforce and practice users
gap: Practice users receive no security training or updates
remediation: Practice user training module and quarterly bulletin (POAM-006)

control_description: Services agreement and BAA with each practice define commitments, incident notice (5 business days), and contacts; external reporting channel
evidence: EV-045 (services agreements); EV-067 (BAAs, 18 of 18); EV-049 (practice contact list)
gap: No written procedure for notifying practices of incidents; no system description shared with practices
remediation: Practice notification step in P08 (POAM-023); management's system description

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service objectives (access, availability within 8 hours of EHR availability, confidentiality) and risk appetite defined
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis including the practice service (register view)
evidence: P01 register (R-038, R-039 and HECS risks)

control_description: Fraud risk considered: payroll diversion, coding manipulation, credential sharing by practice users
gap: Fraud risk not assessed for the practice service specifically
remediation: CFO fraud risk review including practice billing interfaces

control_description: Significant changes (new practices, EHR upgrades, new AI features) assessed before release
gap: EHR upgrade switched on the sepsis model without review; new practices onboarded without a security review
remediation: Change impact review including vendor feature activations; practice onboarding checklist (STD-05; POAM-024)

control_description: Annual co-sourced internal audit (P07); continuous monitoring by the MSSP
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported to the audit committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from SP 800-53 Moderate with tailoring in the SSP
General IT controls: configuration baselines, change control
gap: No baselines for network devices or vendor-managed servers; 23% drift on sampled servers
remediation: Issue STD-01; monthly drift reports (POAM-008)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 and standards deploy controls
gap: 5 standards still in draft
remediation: Issue standards on the P06 schedule

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Identity provider with MFA for external access; role-based EHR access; encryption at rest
evidence: EV-002 (conditional access policy); EV-008 (EHR role catalog); EV-010 (encryption reports)
gap: Generic display accounts; no MFA for on-campus administrator sign-in; standing privileged access
remediation: POAM-002 and POAM-004

control_description: Practice users registered on the practice manager's request with Director of Physician Services approval
gap: Practice manager requests are not verified against practice employment; no end dates
remediation: Sponsor attestation and end dates (POAM-001)

control_description: Role-based access; quarterly review planned; removal on departure
evidence: EV-006 (access review February 2026); P07 AC-2 results
gap: Annual reviews; 7 of 25 non-employee departures still active; transfers keep roles; practice users can see more than their own patients
remediation: Quarterly reviews; monthly practice reconciliation; practice role restriction (POAM-001; POL-02 4.14)

control_description: Badge access to the data center and network closets
gap: 9 keyed closets with no logs
remediation: Badge readers (POAM-015)

control_description: Certified destruction of IT media; device sanitization before return
gap: 4 of 6 device returns lacked certificates
remediation: Certificate before release (POAM-014)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Perimeter and cloud firewalls; MFA for external access; vendor access platform
evidence: EV-014 (firewall exports); EV-015 (vendor access platform logs)
gap: 14 vendor VPN accounts without MFA; flat clinical network
remediation: Vendor access platform for all vendors (POAM-003); segmentation (POAM-019)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS and IPsec for all external traffic, including practice access and interfaces

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all managed endpoints and servers; software installation restricted
evidence: EV-011 (EDR coverage); P07 SI-3 fully satisfied

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Quarterly vulnerability scanning; weekly Known Exploited Vulnerabilities review
gap: Quarterly not monthly; critical findings average 41 days
remediation: Monthly scans and STD-09 targets (POAM-016)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: SIEM monitored 24x7 by the MSSP; EHR VIP access alerts
gap: No broad EHR access analytics; LIS and interface engine not logged
remediation: EHR access analytics and SIEM onboarding (POAM-007)

control_description: Security events triaged by the MSSP and the security team; privacy events by the Privacy Officer
gap: Decision log incomplete in 3 of 9 privacy incidents
remediation: Decision log (POAM-023)

control_description: Incident response plan and two runbooks (P08)
gap: Runbooks not yet exercised; practice notification not tested
remediation: Tabletop 2026-11-10; insider tabletop 2027-02 (POAM-013)

control_description: Recovery from incidents in BIA order
gap: No IT DR plan; no restore tests; practice restoration commitment never tested
remediation: IT DR plan and quarterly restore tests including practice access (POAM-010, POAM-011)

control_description: Weekly change advisory board; EHR build change process with clinical sign-off
gap: Vendor remote changes not ticketed; no second reviewer for interface mapping changes
remediation: Ticket all vendor changes; second reviewer (STD-01)

control_description: Business disruption risks identified in the BIA and mitigated through downtime procedures and insurance
gap: Downtime procedures cover about 4 hours
remediation: 72-hour downtime procedures (POAM-010)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor management for the EHR vendor and other subservice organizations
evidence: EV-041 (BAA register); EV-042 (vendor files); P09 vendor reviews
gap: 42 PHI vendors without BAAs; no Tier 1 reassessment; EHR vendor BAA does not expressly cover practice PHI
remediation: BAAs; annual Tier 1 reviews; EHR vendor BAA amendment (POAM-017)

control_description: Capacity of the help desk and interfaces monitored; EHR capacity is the vendor's (carved out)
evidence: EV-072 (help desk metrics); EV-072 (interface queue reports)

control_description: Environmental protections, backups, and recovery infrastructure for the hospital-managed parts of the service (identity, interfaces, help desk)
evidence: EV-021 (backup reports); EV-052 (data center environmental records)
gap: Backup appliance joined to the directory; alternate communications limited
remediation: POAM-012; POAM-010

control_description: Recovery plan testing
gap: No recovery testing of hospital-managed components
remediation: Quarterly restore tests (POAM-011)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Practice PHI classified as Restricted (POL-04); encrypted at rest and in transit; access by role
gap: Production PHI in the interface engine test environment
remediation: Synthetic test data (POAM-025)

control_description: Disposal of practice data at contract end and of hospital media
evidence: EV-045 (services agreement exit terms); EV-051 (destruction certificates)

remediation: Practice exit procedure
